statements.quote: A customer browses the catalog, places an order and pays.
When payment succeeds the warehouse picks and packs the order
the customer receives a tracking link by email
A customer requests a return within 30 days of delivery.
If the card is declined the customer sees why and can try another card.
If a payment provider call times out, we retry it up to three times before cancelling the order.
Payments are taken through the Stripe API.
The order service writes a row to the stock_levels table when a pick is confirmed.
statements.rewrite: Stock is decremented when a pick is confirmed.

statements.quote: The checkout page must respond within 300 ms at the 95th percentile.
GET /orders/{id} returns the order with its status and tracking link.
statements.rewrite: The customer can see an order's status and tracking link.

statements.quote: We want every order to reach the customer on time and visibly.
